distributionFreeConditionalChaseMath.meaningOfR: Lower bound on our jackpot trigger weight per eligible wager EUR relative to the network wager-flow weight under the chase model.
distributionFreeConditionalChaseMath.criticalQualification: r=1 is not known or assumed. The break-even amount is a diagnostic only and cannot trigger execution.

monotonicityLowerBoundResult.publishedFact: Higher bet gives more chances to win a jackpot.
monotonicityLowerBoundResult.mathematicalConsequence: Monotonic increase alone supplies no strictly positive quantitative lower bound for jackpot hazard at any particular allowed stake. A monotone increasing hazard function may remain arbitrarily close to zero at the chosen stake.
monotonicityLowerBoundResult.executionConsequence: Current public operator wording cannot prove lowerReturnRatio > 1.
